name: 15273-imageprefill-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 8.29B params, ~16 GB of weights over five safetensors shards; a native-resolution vision tower and a 28-layer language model.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 30%, bound 2048 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn image+text: one 1280x720 JPEG (gradient, quality 85, seed 42) plus a 24-token question, 16 output tokens, prompt and output both pinned min=max; the processor keeps native resolution, so the image is 1196 of the ~1226 prompt tokens, and no two requests carry the same pixels.
purpose: A visual question-answering service where eight concurrent users ask short questions about full-resolution photos on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 16
# One prompt's worth of prefill per scheduler step. A request here is ~1241 tokens (1196 image +
# 24 question + 22 of chat template), so this budget admits exactly one prompt per step instead of
# the multimodal default of 5120, which would admit four. Left unset the operating point is a
# four-deep prefill batch, which is not the point this item is declared at.
max-num-batched-tokens: 1240
# MUST STAY INLINE JSON ON ONE LINE -- a block-style mapping loses the key and the engine starts
# without it at rc=0. Must match scenario.json's `images_per_request`.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
disable-mm-preprocessor-cache: true
